items.title: “Demand Is Higher Than Supply”: AMD Has Ripped 141% in 2026. Is It Too Late to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD stock is up 141% in 2026 on Meta’s 6-gigawatt GPU deal and back-to-back record quarters, though it’s still 21% below its October closing high. AMD guided to about $17 billion of fourth-quarter revenue, more than Intel expects, and CEO Lisa Su says demand for AMD’s chips is higher than supply as AI buyers line up a second supplier to Nvidia.

items.title: Intel vs. SK Hynix: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy?
items.summary: SK Hynix's AI memory boom has sent its earnings soaring, while Intel's costly foundry pivot raises a harder question about which bet holds up in the year ahead.

items.title: Quantum Computing’s Next Winners May Not Be Quantum Stocks
items.summary: Quantum processors keep getting better, yet the companies building them keep bleeding cash and shareholders. Behind the earnings misses, a quieter group of giants may be positioning to collect the profits no matter which qubit design prevails.
